16.en: It is not lost, it just has not been found yet. Nothing is ever lost unless it is destroyed. That I can do nothing about, unfortunately

28.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic Arandir} is a finder. People pay her good money to find lost things or lost people. Some call her a bounty hunter, but she never really gets her hands dirty; she identifies accurately where said bounty is holed up, but never goes as far as actually trying to claim it herself. In truth, Arandir is a rogue psyker who does everything she can to hide her powers. She uses them to make money through finding but intends never to use her powers in front of witnesses.

32.en: Gaunt and hollow-faced, with sunken eyes and stringy brown hair, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic} is constantly bundled up in robes and clothes and always seems cold, no matter the temperature. Her thin fingers fidget with the edge of her long coat, and her eyes constantly move about as she sees wisps of the Warp gathering around her. Born into a merchant family, Lethic never took to the family business. She continually wandered away from her duties and often returned with some lost oddity or another. Soon she realised that her ability to find lost items and people could get her paid by those desperately looking for them.

36.en: So far, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Arandir} has been lucky enough to avoid the Inquisition’s notice. She is preternaturally conscious of those looking for her and aims to keep her head down. However, she is savvy (or foolhardy) enough to recognise that befriending a few low-level acolytes and Inquisitorial minions might warn her if the eyes of the Inquisition were about to fall upon her. If she learns who they are, Arandir will be eager to initiate contact with the characters, perhaps approaching them before they even know about her services.

40.en: She primarily uses the Minor and Divination @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1]{Psychic Powers} listed in the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Rogue Psyker} stat-block. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic} can be encountered on any sufficiently populated Imperium world or voidstation.

52.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic} is careful when using her psychic powers, but recently, there was a witness. Lethic asks the characters to silence this witness. She knows exactly where they are, naturally, but they are on the staff of a local noble and stay within their estate. Lethic cannot get close without rousing suspicions.

60.en: A customer has hired @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic }to find an exceedingly rare artefact. Unfortunately, she has tracked the artefact to a @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.actors.Actor.O49jTi2TzoFQH5GT]{Macharian Vigilite} lockup. She needs someone with sufficient authority to access the lockup and retrieve the artefact.

68.en: Naturally, if the characters figure out that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic} is a rogue psyker, they would gain significant trust if they did not hand her over to the authorities or the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.OjmVcVX5lv76LsvL]{Astra Telepathica}. However, if she sees the characters exploiting her with this information, she will aim to disappear and has plentiful plans to do so without them catching her.

84.en: The primary reward for gaining @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic}’s trust is her ‘finding’ abilities, which are handy for finding items relevant to their investigations or Rare or Exotic equipment or items. Until she gains significant confidence in the characters, she will prefer to work alone (to better preserve her secrets). She can accompany the characters in person when greater trust is established, speeding up their findings.

92.en: If she trusts the characters well enough to keep her secret, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.vvgA1lyNkcTDw1xP]{Lethic} is happy to use her powers in front of them or aid them in psychic rituals or related endeavours. (She gains access to the remaining @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.3mzwixuzgerGUpu1.JournalEntryPage.V5zDWussZivkFavj#divination]{Divination} Psychic Power).
